description.value: Nemesis is a specialty coffee roaster and café with five Metro Vancouver locations, including this one at Carrie Cates Court near Lonsdale Quay in North Vancouver. The brand operates its own in-house bakery, Dope Bakehouse, and offers single-origin and signature espresso drinks alongside fresh pastries. It is a compact, no-smoking indoor café — a reliable urban stop for a quality coffee and a croissant mid-ride.
